title: Poker Player Attendance Reliability
dataSources: Steam activity and achievements (`steam:activity`), Chess.com games (`chesscom:game`), online-go matches (`ogs:game`), and poker home-game hands or settlements (`pokerhome:session`).
app: Gaming and play telemetry from Steam, Chess.com, Online-Go servers, and poker home-game logs sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and export files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pokerhome:session
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(attended="true")) as successful by _time player_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for home-game attendance RSVPs by player.
value: Attendance reliability keeps your invite list grounded in who actually shows up.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for home-game attendance RSVPs events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for home-game attendance RSVPs by player.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often home-game attendance RSVPs works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
